record.summary: 142 affordable apartments plus a manager's unit at 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East), owned by Tenderloin Neighborhood Development Corporation (TNDC) per Ventura Partners, with TNDC named as the units' manager in SocketSite's 2016 report, and designed by Mithun Solomon and Studio VARA. SocketSite reported in August 2016 that construction was slated to commence in late September 2016, and Ventura Partners, the project's commercial property manager, lists it as completed in 2019.

facts.value: At OCII's May 2016 approval, staff reported construction was due to start in late August/early September 2016 with completion anticipated in April 2018 (the project was in fact reported complete in 2019)

Happy Lemon (1320 4th St) and SomiSomi (1350 4th St) appear in DataSF's business registry (start dates 2019-07-01 and 2025-02-18), but no readable page shows either operating, so their opening dates and open status are unconfirmed.

record.notes: 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East) -- 142 affordable apartments plus a manager's unit, owned by Tenderloin Neighborhood Development Corporation (TNDC) per Ventura Partners (SocketSite, 2016, names TNDC as the units' manager), designed by Mithun Solomon and Studio VARA, ~$76M cost. Serves households up to 50% of Area Median Income, with 20% of units reserved for formerly homeless families; includes a mews of 12 townhomes and 10 flats facing a mid-block walkway (up to three stories along the western edge) and up to seven ground-floor commercial spaces fronting 4th St. SocketSite (Aug 2016) reported construction slated to commence in late September 2016 and take two years (a forecast; no report of the groundbreaking itself found); Ventura Partners, its commercial property manager, lists the project as completed in 2019; DataSF's Assessor tax roll lists blklot 8711505 as 'Multi-Family Residential' with no year built recorded. OCII's 2016 resolutions give the whole 143-unit development the address 626 Mission Bay Boulevard North; the Assessor lists the separate parcel 8711506 as 626 Mission Bay Bl, Commercial Retail (not part of this parcel). DataSF's own Building Footprints layer only captures small fragments of this building's roof (a handful of small fragments, a few over 100 sq m, totaling well under the real footprint) rather than its full mass, confirmed visually against satellite imagery -- so this record uses the real Assessor parcel boundary (a single-building, single-parcel site) rather than the incomplete building-footprint layer, consistent with how every other real-parcel record here is drawn.
